Reviewer: m3 pool job review-4408, Claude Fable 5.2 (`claude-fable-5-2`), mkinney seat (`.claude-mkinney`); did not write or refresh this PR.

**Needs changes before merge.** One blocker. The tests, the gate and the layout are good.

This is a safety-tier review: the PR adds a posted program (`five-axis.nc`). I ran three mutations and I checked the program with an independent geometry script.

## What looks good

- The case folder obeys `examples/catalog/README.md`: `model/` with its generator, `build.camscript`, `case.toml`, `.camproj`, `.nc`, `README.md`.
- The script requires a clean `cam.verify()` before it saves and posts.
- The generator reproduces `model/five-axis.obj` byte for byte.
- The new test file joins the existing `example_catalog` suite. It makes no new test binary.
- The decision record has the required format. The body has the `Changelog:` line, the "Goldens moved" list and `Fixes #2870`.
- The diff changes no application code, no check, no dependency and no process file.
- Each operation section states `A` and `B` in a rapid move before the first tilted feed (lines 13-14, 1350-1351, 2204-2205).

## Results, merged with main

Built locally on `m3`, in a trial merge of e850da857 with upstream/main c79c9b24f. The merge is clean. No runner was used.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 10 steps, 0 failed |
| `app suites: example_catalog` | 47 passed, 0 failed, 4 ignored |
| `catalog_multiaxis_five_axis::posts_three_clean_five_axis_operations`, `::regenerates`, `::rebuilds` | 3 passed |
| `cargo xtask catalog --check` | 16 cases checked, `multiaxis/five-axis` included |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo xtask gate light` | 6 steps, 0 failed |

Time of the case on a host without load: `regenerates` 9.4 s, `rebuilds` 11.4 s. The budget is 60 s.
Note: with a host load average of 63 on 16 CPUs (other jobs), one run of the three pins took 47 s and two runs stopped at the 60 s budget. Without that load the times are stable. This is not a finding.

### Extra suites run

- Test data: the diff adds files below `examples/catalog/`. The readers of that directory are `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`, `catalog_groove_part_off` (all in the quick gate, green) and the `xtask` catalog tests (`cargo test -p xtask catalog`: 26 passed).
- `crates/ui/tests/catalog_render.rs` is `#[ignore]`d (it needs a GPU). I did not run it.
- Importers: the diff does not touch import code. I did not run the kernel suites.
- Heavy lanes: not run. The diff reaches no generator, post, simulation or geometry code.

### Mutations (each on the trial merge, then restored)

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| `five-axis.nc` line 1351: `A10.903` to `A10.904` | `regenerates` red ("regenerated NC differs"), `rebuilds` red ("build.camscript NC differs from committed .nc") |
| `case.toml`: remove `"5-Axis Flow"` from `kinds` | `posts_three_clean_five_axis_operations` red ("metadata must name 5-Axis Flow"); `cargo xtask catalog --check` red ("example links missing or stale") |
| `build.camscript`: Flow `stepover` 3.0 to 3.5 | `rebuilds` red ("build.camscript NC differs from committed .nc"); `regenerates` green, as expected |

After the restore, `git status` is clean and the three pins are green.

### Program check (`five-axis.nc`, 3558 lines)

I read the program with a script that follows the modal state of each line.

- Structure: `G21`, three sections, each with `G90 G17 G94 G54 G40 G49 G80`, `T01 M6`, `G43 H01`, `S9000 M3`, `M8`, `G43.4 H01`. The end is `G49`, `G91 G28 Z0`, `G00 A0. B0.`, `G91 G28 X0 Y0`, `M30`.
- 3357 feed moves. Each `G01` has an `F` word. No feed comes before the rotary pose is stated. No feed is outside `G43.4`.
- `A` is in -59.63 to 59.67. `B` is in -90 to 90. The machine travel is -120 to 120 for each. `max_tilt_deg: 60` holds.
- The feeds are in 19.0 to 500 mm/min. The low values are on moves that turn a rotary.
- I rebuilt the tool axis of each feed from its `A` and `B` words with the pose law of `crates/cl/src/cl/pose.rs` (`axis = Ry(B) · Rx(A) · Z`). I measured the ball and the flank against the 16-sided prism of the OBJ. The deepest contact is 0.054 mm. The tolerance of the operations is 0.1 mm. Thus the program agrees with the path that `cam.verify()` judged.
- The repositioning rapids are 8.5 mm or more away from the stock box. I did not judge the retract rapids that start in the cut: that needs the stock simulation, which the body lists as not exercised.

## Requested before merge

### 1. BLOCKER (P1 class, wrong posted G-code): the `A` and `B` words do not agree with the rotary chain of the Tilt-head machine

Class: a catalog golden that records rotary words which the stated machine reads as a different tool axis.

`examples/catalog/multiaxis/five-axis/five-axis.nc` (for example line 1240, `G01 X24.443 Y8.747 Z7.178 A-40.588 B68.859 F88.9`):

- The stream letters follow the pose law `axis = Ry(B) · Rx(A) · Z` (`crates/cl/src/cl/pose.rs:10-14`). In that law, B is the outer rotation and A is the inner rotation.
- `assets/posts/fanuc.cps:348-380` (`tilt()`) writes those letters as they come, below `G43.4`. It does not express them again for the machine.
- `assets/machines/tilthead.mch:11-14` nests B in A: the A rotary carries the B rotary, and B carries the head. For joint angles A and B, that chain gives the tool axis `Rx(A) · Ry(B) · Z`.
- The two products are equal only when A or B is zero. In this program, 2365 of 3357 feeds have A and B not zero. On 1882 feeds the two axes differ by more than 1 degree, on 1090 feeds by more than 5 degrees. The largest difference is 27.3 degrees (line 1240).
- With the chain order of the machine file, my geometry check finds the tool up to 0.37 mm into the model (lines 1007-1008, 1069-1070), and 432 feeds deeper than 0.15 mm. With the pose law order the deepest value is 0.054 mm.
- A second sign: the README tells the reader to look for `A15.` / `A-15.` at `B90.` / `B-90.` (lines 784, 894, 940, 988). On a chain where A carries B, the tool at B90 is parallel to the A axis, so the A word cannot give a lead there.

The diff of this PR does not cause this. The generator, the post and the machine file on main cause it. But this PR records the result as a golden and links it from the guide as the example for Swarf, 5-Axis Contour and 5-Axis Flow on that machine. Issue #2870 says: "File each refusal or wrong output that the work finds as its own bug."

I found no open issue for this. My reading of the machine file is the assumption in this finding: "the nest chain is the kinematics" (`assets/machines/AGENTS.md`). If the maintainer decides that the nest of `tilthead.mch` means B carries A, the finding does not apply, and the machine file or its documentation must say so.

Requested:

1. File the defect as its own issue (P1, `area:multiaxis`) and link it on #2392.
2. Close the whole class with one rule, not this one case: when a machine states two tilting rotaries, the post (or the program gate) must express the stream pose in the joint angles of the stated chain, or refuse by name a chain that the dialect cannot express. A recorded program must then come from that rule.
3. Hold this case until that issue is decided. Then rebuild `five-axis.nc` and `five-axis.camproj` with `cargo xtask catalog --case multiaxis/five-axis`, and correct the README line about `A15.` at `B90.` if the words change.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

- Commit e8dd91ed3 has the subject `wip(catalog): ...`. `wip` is not a Conventional Commits type of AGENTS.md. The commit is pushed, and a force-push is not permitted, so I do not request a change.
- README: "The clearance plane is Z = 25 mm." In the Swarf section, 25 linking rapids end below Z25 (lowest tip Z17.254, line 1246) and turn A and B there. They stay 8.5 mm or more away from the stock box, so this is a wording point only.
- The first Swarf pass enters with the tool horizontal (`B90.`) and feeds the full flank down into the stock corner at `F100.` (line 15). This is a cut, not a collision. The README says correctly that the case is not a production sequence.
- The case selects no holder. On a real tilt-head, the spindle body (90 mm diameter in `tilthead.mch`) is near the part at `B90.` with a 60 mm flute. The README says that the tool assembly is not physical. A later case with a holder would show more.

## Labels and state

- `needs-rework` set. The PR stays a draft; I did not flag it ready.
- The PR is MERGEABLE with main.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

## Finding 1 (BLOCKER): the `A` and `B` words do not agree with the rotary chain of the Tilt-head machine

1. Requested: file the defect as its own issue and link it on #2392.
   - Done. The issue is #4417 (`bug`, `P1`, `area:multiaxis`, `area:post`, `effort:high`, `source:agent`).
   - I searched the open and closed issues first. I found no duplicate.
   - #2392 has a comment that links #4417.
2. Requested: close the whole class with one rule.
   - Not done in this PR. The rule changes post logic on main. This PR changes no application code.
   - The rule is the "Done means" list of #4417. That issue states the whole class: each machine with two tilting rotaries, each dialect that writes the stream letters as joint angles.
   - #4417 also states the assumption of the review ("A carries B") for the decision of the maintainer.
3. Requested: hold this case until that issue is decided.
   - Done. The PR stays a draft at e850da857. `needs-rework` stays.
   - #2870 has a hold comment and is marked as blocked by #4417.
   - After #4417 is decided, the next round does these steps: merge upstream main, run `cargo xtask catalog --case multiaxis/five-axis`, rebuild `five-axis.nc` and `five-axis.camproj`, correct the README line about `A15.` at `B90.` if the words change, and run the three pins and the quick gate again.

## Evidence

- No tree change, thus no new pin and no gate run in this round. The results of the review on e850da857 are still the current results.
- I confirmed the three code readings of the review on upstream main 878f8c2f2: the pose law in `crates/cl/src/cl/pose.rs`, the `tilt()` function in `assets/posts/fanuc.cps`, and the nest of `assets/machines/tilthead.mch`.
- I did not repeat the geometry measurement of the review.

## Notes of the review that do not block

I made no change for them. They do not request one. The README wording point (clearance plane) goes into the rebuild round, because the README changes there.

A re-review is not necessary before #4417 is decided. Please review again after the rebuild round.
